Tweet by @johnennis (John Ennis)
Author bio: Math, AI, Sensory Science, CEO https://t.co/FL95WTce2l, author of @elves_skill
Text: I think when people see a lot of the recent spectacular results, especially in math, they think the models are getting a lot smarter

And while it is true that the intelligence of the models is marginally improving, what has really improved is the harnessing and orchestration

I really believe that models are basically starting to top out when it comes to intelligence because they are only really good at certain types of problems and tasks, and in many cases, such as routine coding, they are now effectively perfect

That doesn’t mean that there’s not still a ton of space to grow, but I think we’re starting to reach the limit of what LLMs can do
